cooledRest.source: engine/risk.ts COOLED_REST.wbgtC — ADOSH-SF CoP 11.0 v4.0 §3.2(c) cooled and air-conditioned rest areas; §3.2(b)(vii) cooled shelter in the midday break; [ENG] conservative cabin design: 26 °C / 55 % RH ≈ 21–22 °C WBGT, 25 °C allows for door openings and crowding

config.clothing: ordinary work clothes / cloth coveralls (ACGIH CAV 0, no hood): WBGT_eff = WBGT
notes: Model grid-cell values, not station or worksite measurements: the analysis carries about ±1.0–1.2 °C WBGT error against airport METARs (data_and_validation.md §6.3; see observationalAnchor and forecast-skill.json).

The primary run applies no site radiant allowance (the meteorological exposure, as in the research preview); the ifs_site_boost run shows the effect of the [ENG] per-site allowance for hot work surfaces.
Band edges are computed from the engine equations (REL(300 W) = 28.21, RAL(115 W) = 30.84, REL(115 W) = 33.00 °C) and the Qatar 32.1 °C stop value; lower edges are inclusive.

Hours 13:00 and 14:00 local fall inside the midday-break window on 15 Jun–15 Sep; outdoor work in direct sun is banned there, so the allowed-work numbers for those hours apply only to the season dates outside the ban.

workRest.method: limits.ts allowedWorkFraction per hour: largest f with Limit(f·M_work + (1−f)·115 W) ≥ f·WBGT_sun + (1−f)·WBGT_rest (1-h TWA, NIOSH 2016 §8.1 / ACGIH). WBGT_rest = cooled cabin (min(cabin WBGT, shade WBGT), as risk.ts) or the modelled engineered-shade WBGT. Minutes = 60·f; zeroShare = share of hours with no work allowed.

cooledRest.source: engine/risk.ts COOLED_REST.wbgtC — ADOSH-SF CoP 11.0 v4.0 §3.2(c) cooled and air-conditioned rest areas; §3.2(b)(vii) cooled shelter in the midday break; [ENG] conservative cabin design: 26 °C / 55 % RH ≈ 21–22 °C WBGT, 25 °C allows for door openings and crowding

researchComparison.note: The preview used thermofeel with radiation configuration A; the engine uses configuration B (§6.5 sensitivity: seasonal counts within 1 %). Counts are mean hours per season.

observationalAnchor.note: Hours per WBGT band over the matched METAR hours of summer 2025 at the airport model cells: METAR T/Td/wind with IFS 9 km radiation (obs-met) versus model-only WBGT (data_and_validation.md §10 A.4(b)). Airports stand in for the sites only approximately.
